guideDescription: A fresh-level-80 path into proactive HoTs, five-player triage, mana control, recovery tools, and later raid progression.

mechanics.label: HoTs
mechanics.use: Pre-HoT predictable damage with Rejuvenation and Regrowth while avoiding wasteful blanket healing in small groups.

mechanics.label: Lifebloom
mechanics.use: Choose deliberately between rolling a stack, letting it bloom, and using Clearcasting for efficient healing and mana return.

mechanics.label: Raid healing
mechanics.use: Use Wild Growth for real clustered damage and Swiftmend for urgent recovery while preserving assignment coverage.

mechanics.label: Mana and procs
mechanics.use: Track mana, Clearcasting, Innervate, Revitalize, and expensive direct heals so recovery tools remain available.

talent.name: Fresh-80 self-contained Tree of Life baseline
talent.summary: Use the fully allocated healing baseline for five-player triage, HoTs, Nourish, Swiftmend, mana support, and recovery. Treat Celestial Focus as a later whole-build comparison.

pageDescriptions.quickStart: Start at level 80 with Tree of Life, proactive HoTs, five-player triage, mana rules, and a dungeon-ready checklist.
pageDescriptions.playing: Choose between HoTs, Lifebloom, Wild Growth, Swiftmend, Nourish, movement, mana, and recovery tools by damage pattern.
pageDescriptions.setup: Install the 11/0/60 build, glyphs, mouseover macros, addons, raid frames, and required tracking.
pageDescriptions.building: Build spell power and sustainable haste, then balance Spirit, MP5, Intellect, budget gems, enchants, and later GCD goals.
pageDescriptions.equipping: Target normal and heroic dungeon, reputation, crafted, emblem, catch-up, ToC, ICC, and Ruby Sanctum healing upgrades.
pageDescriptions.raiding: Handle tank support, raid coverage, dispels, Innervate, Rebirth, movement, and encounter responsibilities by mode.

serverNote: Standard original-client WotLK 3.3.5a behavior is the baseline. Verify Lifebloom refunds, Wild Growth targeting, Swiftmend glyph behavior, Rejuvenation haste, Revitalize, and Tranquility coverage on Hellscream.
footer: Unofficial player-made Hellscream guide. Verify live tooltips, raid assignments, and server scripting.
